description: Bunch of robotics nerds interested in space
summary: Our project was a Mission Planner Video game. Our main objective was to make an easy and beginner friendly introduction to a space mission design, while adressing real-world engineering concerns like power generation and reliability, mass and delta-v budget and the need of balancing system capability and cost. Our concept assumed making a user friendly interface with a reliable, realistic engine working to simulate mission's trajectiories. We believe making such seemingly complicated topics easy to manage and understand is a key to encourage young people to get involved with space sector.
details: Our project was made to introduce the basics of designing a space mission. It allows user to pick from the most important mission components, like flight trajectory, engine and additional tech to help mission succed. Project was made nearly entirely in Unity engine, with use of C#, and Blender used for 3D modelling. We believe it allows individuals who are just starting their journey in Space sector to familiarise themselves with basics of mission desing in an easy and friendly way. We have considered real-world trajectory adjustment maneuvers, as well as genuine engineering concerns in mission design - power generation and reliability, mass and delta-v budget and the need of balancing system capability and cost.
